errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the diagram does not show grouped bars. The chart is a grouped bar chart, with bars for each region grouped by year. This statement also contradicts a previous correct observation in the same text that "всяка година е представена с група от пет стълба" (each year is represented by a group of five bars).
